public.text: The section correctly identifies temporal geography as a major challenge but does not state how historical boundary versions, facility assignments, and indicator recalculation should be represented technically.
public.suggestedRevision: Require persistent administrative-area identifiers, effective periods, versioned geometries, historical relationships, provenance, and defined rules for retrospective reporting and recalculation.
